name: ListenBrainz
description: Charts and recommendations under CC0 from ListenBrainz, the open listening-history project of the MetaBrainz Foundation: the songs most listened to this week, month, year and of all time, genre radios, artists like an artist, an artist's best-known songs and fresh releases, and radios of similar songs. No account needed. Cover art from the Cover Art Archive.
author: Raygun
